findings.label: TESTED
findings.title: Release suite does not pin refusal codes; 12 of 30 helper mutants survive it
findings.evidence: refused() accepts any exception (test_s1_pair_cx3v002.py L114-119), and the launcher AST test compares functions only, not constants such as LOCK. Survivors G01-G03, G07-G10, G12, G13, L05, W05, W08; helper probes kill 10 of the 12 (P01, P02, P13, P06-P09, P11, P12, P18); W05 and W08 duplicate guard L352-354 (equivalent). Recommendation: add the probes as non-gating regression controls.

findings.label: TESTED
findings.title: Codex3's one_C1_for_both mutant does not exercise a shared C1
findings.evidence: It dies at assembly on S1_PAIR_CHILD_CALL_BINDING (guard L376). A shared C1 is refused by S1_PAIR_DISTINCT_C1_REQUIRED (L355-356; P13, R10); crossed C1s by native preflight (G04, R10).

findings.label: FORMAL+TESTED
findings.title: Distinct-C1 check compares {path, sha} references, not content
findings.evidence: A byte copy of the S1 C1 at another path passes L356; native preflight then refuses it (R10). Forged input only (A115).

findings.label: TESTED
findings.title: Pair wrapper relaxations versus the old path
findings.evidence: campaign_window ignored, including the old INACTIVE-window refusal (lib L1179-1183; R04), consistent with A274 item 4; no spawn timeout (root L62; old _spawn 600 s, lib L1317); NUMEXPR/BLIS thread variables added (root L14), no physics effect since the monitor forces all six to 1.

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: pair_case_admission re-checks only part of guard014 validate per child
findings.evidence: e.g. it does not re-allowlist the child's original guard/launcher/monitor/driver within the child's own sources; honest children come from binder011's full guard014 validate (README L22; R02). Forged children only.

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: The assembler copies ROOT_AUTHORIZED status/authority from the C3T child into the parent candidate
findings.evidence: bind L77-85. Authority is root's independent publication of the bound parent digest (README L49; validate L392-397). Root should review the parent like any other admission.

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: Launcher015 behaviour now governs the pair
findings.evidence: per-call disk check = that call's cap + 20 GiB (launcher L117, L123; batch check covers both, TESTED); a non-systemic C3T end before its first iteration drains the worker, so C4T needs its own later batch (old single-call path admits it, R02); both native preflights re-run every 60 s poll (L97), production duration UNTESTED.

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: Concurrency may lengthen each call against the 100,800 s wall cap
findings.evidence: DBP C2V004B e239d21e; a wall stop is an uncounted infrastructure rerun (A133(c), C17). DBP POST_S1 already sets max_active 2. UNTESTED risk.

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: The binder's command file skips the pair wrapper's S1 checks
findings.evidence: bind L48-51; same as the old path; README L59 forbids using it.

findings.label: FORMAL
findings.title: Root's A226 item-3 envelope must cover the nested child inputs
findings.evidence: child admissions, child plans, both C1s and prelaunch records (README L57); whether the envelope tool follows nested pins is UNTESTED here.

reads_not_done: No run trees, run outputs or NGC data; no launches, no network; synthetic fixtures only (claude_artifacts/verify_c3_s1_pair/fixtures_helper/, about 144 MB) and scratch copies. One hung scratch probe process (mutant L04) was killed by the helper.
